# Every route on toskar.api

*Generated by `python/scripts/reference.py`.*

One method per route, named after its operation in Core's API spec. `AsyncToskar`'s `api` has the same methods, awaited. Methods with a body take it as `body=`, a dict; answers are the `toskar.models` types.

| Method | Route | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `get_about()` | `GET /about` | AGPL corresponding-source offer |
| `list_apikeys()` | `GET /api/v1/api-keys` | API keys, without their secrets |
| `create_apikey(*, body: dict[str, Any])` | `POST /api/v1/api-keys` | Create an API key; the secret is shown only in this response |
| `delete_apikey(id: str)` | `DELETE /api/v1/api-keys/{id}` | Delete an API key |
| `set_apikey_permissions(id: str, *, body: dict[str, Any] \| None = None)` | `PUT /api/v1/api-keys/{id}/permissions` | Change what an API key may ask of the assistant |
| `rotate_apikey(id: str)` | `POST /api/v1/api-keys/{id}/rotate` | Replace a key's secret; the old one stops working |
| `upload_artifact(*, body: dict[str, Any])` | `POST /api/v1/artifacts` | Upload a file to attach to a chat (up to 25 MB) |
| `get_artifact(id: str)` | `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}` | One file |
| `delete_artifact(id: str)` | `DELETE /api/v1/artifacts/{id}` | Delete a file |
| `get_artifact_content(id: str, *, inline: str \| None = None)` | `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/content` | A file's content |
| `list_automations()` | `GET /api/v1/automations` | Automations with their last result |
| `create_automation(*, body: models.AutomationInput \| dict[str, Any])` | `POST /api/v1/automations` | Create an automation |
| `parse_automation(*, body: dict[str, Any])` | `POST /api/v1/automations/parse` | Read a request such as "every morning at 8, tell me if the price is below $500" into an automation |
| `preview_automation(*, body: models.AutomationInput \| dict[str, Any])` | `POST /api/v1/automations/preview` | Check an automation and show its next runs without saving it |
| `get_automation(id: str)` | `GET /api/v1/automations/{id}` | An automation with its run history |
| `update_automation(id: str, *, body: models.AutomationInput \| dict[str, Any])` | `PATCH /api/v1/automations/{id}` | Change only the fields given |
| `delete_automation(id: str)` | `DELETE /api/v1/automations/{id}` | Delete an automation |
| `make_automation_hook(id: str)` | `POST /api/v1/automations/{id}/hook` | Make a webhook trigger's link |
| `pause_automation(id: str)` | `POST /api/v1/automations/{id}/pause` | Pause an automation |
| `resume_automation(id: str)` | `POST /api/v1/automations/{id}/resume` | Resume an automation |
| `run_automation(id: str)` | `POST /api/v1/automations/{id}/run` | Run an automation now |
| `list_automation_runs(id: str, *, before: str \| None = None, limit: int \| None = None)` |  | A page of an automation's runs, newest first |
| `continue_automation_run(id: str, run_id: str)` |  | Open a run's result in a chat to reply to |
| `list_benchmarks()` | `GET /api/v1/benchmarks` | List recent benchmark jobs |
| `start_benchmark(*, body: models.BenchmarkRequest \| dict[str, Any])` | `POST /api/v1/benchmarks` | Start a multi-model benchmark |
| `list_benchmark_workloads()` |  | List benchmark workload categories |

| `cancel_benchmark(id: str)` | `POST /api/v1/benchmarks/{id}/cancel` | Cancel a running benchmark |

| `clear_cache(name: str)` | `POST /api/v1/caches/{name}/clear` | Clear one cache |
